primary_triggers.rationale: Elevated TTL indicates local subnet or internal lateral propagation.
Unrecognized or non-standard application layer protocol identifier (131) on transport port.
TCP receive window abnormally expanded (8192 bytes) — indicates bulk encrypted payload delivery or data exfiltration burst.

recommended_actions: [X] Terminate suspect process PID and sever persistent outbound reverse shell socket.

[X] Invalidate all active Kerberos/SSH credentials associated with the compromised host.
[V] Review bastion and lateral jump logs for post-exploitation reconnaissance.

recommended_actions: [X] Engage upstream ISP BGP Flowspec drop rules to discard volumetric attack traffic.

[V] Divert edge ingress traffic through cloud DDoS scrubbing center.
